abstract.t:
An action record can say which controlled state was in force when an artefact was produced. It usually cannot say _which state the record was compared against_, so the question "is the state that was in force still the state now?" has to be answered by asking the producer at verification time.
This document defines one field, compared_state, and four processing rules, so that a verifier can decide the state question from the record alone, and so that a later comparison is expressible as a new sealed revision rather than an edit.
This is a field definition, not a framework. It adds nothing to the envelope, the lifecycle, or the absence taxonomy of the profiles it references.
